notes: Prices as held in NOVA on 2026-11-10, 2026 tariff year. NOVA carries no validity date: it shows the prices in force on the day of the import.

NOVA does not link a zone price to a product; the link is derived from the order of the entries (price-ladders/README.md) and, inside a product, from the rank of the prices: more zones never cost less.
Not checked against a published tariff, and incomplete or resting on an assumption (see the notes below).
Senior prices are given only where NOVA shows them; without one, seniors may pay the adult price or the reduced one, NOVA does not say. Flexi and weekly passes are not read.

month: read from SION_ABONNEMENTS_MENSUELS "Sion Abonnements mensuels"; other products of the same kind on the alliance's plans, not used: 765_SION_2EME_ENFANT_MENSUEL "Sion Abo 2ème enfant mensuel", 765_SION_3EME_ENFANT_MENSUEL "Sion Abo 3ème enfant mensuel", SION_ABONNEMENTS_MENSUELS_LOCAL "Sion Abonnements mensuels local".

Junior and senior pass prices are told apart by counting entries (NOVA marks both "reduced"): one entry is read as the junior price, two as the senior price. Categories concerned here: senior, junior.
Not found or not usable: year (year: 765_SION_2EME_ENFANT_ANNUEL not usable (a pay level without adult price)).

text: Read from NOVA pay levels: passes from 1 zone(s), no all-zones level; tickets from 1 zone(s), no all-zones level.
Zones sold together, city-zone and short-trip prices and overlap rules of the tariff are not in this file.
